description: This Rust source file implements the ILights AIDL interface for managing device lights, including setting light states and reporting supported lights, with internal data structures, external dependencies, and network communication via a VsockServer.

classes.name: Light
classes.description: Internal data structure representing a hardware light and its current state.

classes.name: LightsService
classes.description: Implements the ILights interface, managing a collection of lights and a VsockServer for communication.

methods.name: new
methods.description: Constructs a new LightsService with a given set of hardware lights, initializing the internal map and VsockServer.

methods.name: default
methods.description: Provides a default instance of LightsService with a single battery light.

methods.name: setLightState
methods.description: Sets the state of a specified light by ID and updates the external VsockServer.

methods.name: getLights
methods.description: Returns a list of all supported hardware lights.
